source.text_it: L'infortunio occorso ad un turista a bordo di un autobus durante il trasporto è considerato infortunio sul lavoro

records.localized_text: An injury to a tourist aboard a bus during transport is considered an occupational accident.

source.text_it: Non costituisce infortunio sul lavoro la lesione subita dal lavoratore nel caso in cui non utilizzi, per negligenza, i dispositivi di protezione individuale imposti dal datore di lavoro

records.localized_text: An injury to a worker who negligently fails to use employer-required personal protective equipment is not an occupational accident.

source.text_it: Gli elementi che caratterizzano gli infortuni sul lavoro sono: l'occasione di lavoro, la causa violenta e la lesione invalidante

records.localized_text: Occupational accidents are characterised by a work connection, a violent cause and disabling injury.

source.text_it: Ogni danneggiamento organico o funzionale del lavoratore conseguente all'attività lavorativa costituisce infortunio sul lavoro

records.localized_text: Any organic or functional damage to a worker resulting from work constitutes an occupational accident.

source.text_it: Il danno fisico subito dal conducente che cade accidentalmente nella cisterna costituisce infortunio sul lavoro

records.localized_text: Physical injury to a driver who accidentally falls into a tank constitutes an occupational accident.

source.text_it: L'assunzione eccessiva di alcool durante i periodi di riposo obbligatorio costituisce infortunio sul lavoro

records.localized_text: Excessive alcohol consumption during mandatory rest periods constitutes an occupational accident.

source.text_it: La lesione alla vista determinata dall'accidentale contatto con il materiale corrosivo trasportato costituisce infortunio sul lavoro

records.localized_text: Eye injury caused by accidental contact with corrosive cargo constitutes an occupational accident.

source.text_it: Durante l'attività professionale, il conducente è esposto a lesioni conseguenti a incendio

records.localized_text: During professional activity, a driver is exposed to injuries resulting from fire.

source.text_it: La maggior parte degli incidenti stradali è attribuibile a comportamenti scorretti del conducente

records.localized_text: Most road accidents are attributable to incorrect driver behaviour.

source.text_it: Una velocità non adeguata è tra le cause più ricorrenti di incidenti stradali

records.localized_text: Inappropriate speed is among the most frequent causes of road accidents.

source.text_it: Il mancato rispetto delle norme sulla precedenza è tra le cause più ricorrenti di incidenti stradali

records.localized_text: Failure to obey priority rules is among the most frequent causes of road accidents.

source.text_it: La distrazione alla guida è tra le cause più ricorrenti di incidenti stradali

records.localized_text: Driver distraction is among the most frequent causes of road accidents.

source.text_it: Il mancato rispetto della distanza di sicurezza è tra le cause più ricorrenti di incidenti stradali

records.localized_text: Failure to maintain a safety distance is among the most frequent causes of road accidents.

source.text_it: La stanchezza del conducente aumenta il rischio di incidente stradale

records.localized_text: Driver fatigue increases the risk of a road accident.

source.text_it: Il malfunzionamento delle sospensioni è tra le cause di incidenti stradali

records.localized_text: Suspension malfunction is among the causes of road accidents.

source.text_it: I pneumatici con battistrada usurato aumentano il rischio di incidenti stradali

records.localized_text: Tyres with worn tread increase the risk of road accidents.

source.text_it: Il malfunzionamento dei freni è tra le cause di incidenti stradali

records.localized_text: Brake malfunction is among the causes of road accidents.

source.text_it: Il guasto del tachigrafo è tra le cause più ricorrenti di incidenti stradali

records.localized_text: Tachograph failure is among the most frequent causes of road accidents.

source.text_it: Il malfunzionamento della pompa di iniezione è tra le cause più ricorrenti di incidenti stradali

records.localized_text: Injection pump malfunction is among the most frequent causes of road accidents.

source.text_it: La mancanza di estintori a bordo del veicolo aumenta il rischio di incidenti stradali

records.localized_text: Lack of fire extinguishers aboard increases the risk of road accidents.

source.text_it: L'avaria alla pompa dell'acqua aumenta il rischio di incidenti stradali

records.localized_text: Water pump failure increases the risk of road accidents.

source.text_it: Il filtro dell'aria intasato aumenta il rischio di incidente stradale

records.localized_text: A clogged air filter increases the risk of a road accident.

source.text_it: La tipologia di combustibile (gasolio, GPL, metano) aumenta il rischio di incidente stradale

records.localized_text: The type of fuel, diesel, LPG or methane, increases the risk of a road accident.

source.text_it: La psicologia del traffico riguarda anche lo studio dei fattori umani e sociali associati alla promozione di condotte di guida sicure e mobilità sostenibile

records.localized_text: Traffic psychology also studies human and social factors associated with safe driving and sustainable mobility.

source.text_it: La concentrazione del conducente è tra i fattori cognitivi che sembrano influire maggiormente sulle condotte di guida

records.localized_text: Driver concentration is among the cognitive factors that appear to influence driving behaviour most.

rows.text: The tourist is travelling as a passenger, not doing the driver’s work. An accident does not become a workplace accident merely because it occurs on the bus.
evidence: https://www.inail.it/portale/assicurazione/it/lassicurazione-inail/La-tutela-assicurativa-nell-ue/Incidenti-e-infortuni-sul-lavoro.html — definizione: causa violenta, occasione di lavoro e conseguenze lesive.

rows.text: Negligence in using protective equipment does not automatically rule out a workplace accident. The connection with work matters, except in particular cases of voluntary risk unrelated to the work.
evidence: https://www.inail.it/portale/assicurazione/it/lassicurazione-inail/La-tutela-assicurativa-nell-ue/Incidenti-e-infortuni-sul-lavoro.html — definizione: causa violenta, occasione di lavoro e conseguenze lesive.
https://www.inail.it/content/dam/inail-hub-site/documenti/2020/02/Bozza3%20Riv%20Inf%201%202017.pdf — occasione di lavoro comprende anche negligenza; distingue il rischio elettivo.

rows.text: There must be a sudden injurious cause connected with work, producing an injury with disabling consequences. An event at the workplace alone is not enough.
evidence: https://www.inail.it/portale/assicurazione/it/lassicurazione-inail/La-tutela-assicurativa-nell-ue/Incidenti-e-infortuni-sul-lavoro.html — definizione: causa violenta, occasione di lavoro e conseguenze lesive.

rows.text: The quiz marks this TRUE: work-related harm to the body or its function can be an occupational accident. The insurance definition also requires a violent cause and a connection with work; a slowly developing occupational disease is distinct.
evidence: Official CQC 31828 printed VERO; broad wording omits conditions rather than necessarily asserting that no conditions apply.

INAIL https://www.inail.it/portale/assicurazione/it/lassicurazione-inail/La-tutela-assicurativa-nell-ue/Incidenti-e-infortuni-sul-lavoro.html — violent cause and work occasion; INAIL coauthored research article 2013 printed p.405, PDF p.7 https://www.inail.it/content/dam/inail-hub-site/documenti/2016/01/ILRISCHIOBIOLOGICO,1.pdf — gradual occupational disease distinguished.

rows.text: If the fall into the tank occurs during work, it is a sudden event connected with work; the resulting injury can be a workplace accident.
evidence: https://www.inail.it/portale/assicurazione/it/lassicurazione-inail/La-tutela-assicurativa-nell-ue/Incidenti-e-infortuni-sul-lavoro.html — definizione: causa violenta, occasione di lavoro e conseguenze lesive.

rows.text: Drinking too much during rest is not in itself a workplace accident: it is not an injury caused by a sudden event in connection with work.
evidence: https://www.inail.it/portale/assicurazione/it/lassicurazione-inail/La-tutela-assicurativa-nell-ue/Incidenti-e-infortuni-sul-lavoro.html — definizione: causa violenta, occasione di lavoro e conseguenze lesive.

rows.text: Accidental contact with corrosive material during transport is a sudden event connected with work; the resulting eye injury can be a workplace accident.
evidence: https://www.inail.it/portale/assicurazione/it/lassicurazione-inail/La-tutela-assicurativa-nell-ue/Incidenti-e-infortuni-sul-lavoro.html — definizione: causa violenta, occasione di lavoro e conseguenze lesive.
https://www.osha.gov/ords/imis/establishment.inspection_detail?id=309284479 — caso documentato di ustioni chimiche a un conducente durante operazioni su cisterna.

rows.text: A fire during transport operations can expose the driver to burns and other injuries.
evidence: https://www.osha.gov/ords/imis/accidentsearch.accident_detail?id=202614442 — caso documentato di autista ustionato in un incendio durante un intervento su un camion.

rows.text: Driving errors occur in many crashes: distraction, speed and failure to yield are examples. Road and vehicle factors can also contribute.
evidence: https://www.istat.it/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/REPORT_INCIDENTI_STRADALI_2024.pdf, prospetto 9 e sezione sulle circostanze — distrazione, precedenza, velocità e distanza tra le circostanze più frequenti degli incidenti rilevati.

rows.text: Excessive or inappropriate speed leaves less room to react and stop; excessive speed is among the most frequent circumstances recorded in crashes.
evidence: https://www.istat.it/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/REPORT_INCIDENTI_STRADALI_2024.pdf, prospetto 9 e sezione sulle circostanze — distrazione, precedenza, velocità e distanza tra le circostanze più frequenti degli incidenti rilevati.

rows.text: Failing to yield can cause paths to cross without the necessary clearance; it is among the most frequent circumstances recorded in crashes.
evidence: https://www.istat.it/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/REPORT_INCIDENTI_STRADALI_2024.pdf, prospetto 9 e sezione sulle circostanze — distrazione, precedenza, velocità e distanza tra le circostanze più frequenti degli incidenti rilevati.

rows.text: Distraction takes attention away from the road and can delay recognition of danger; it is among the most frequent circumstances recorded in crashes.
evidence: https://www.istat.it/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/REPORT_INCIDENTI_STRADALI_2024.pdf, prospetto 9 e sezione sulle circostanze — distrazione, precedenza, velocità e distanza tra le circostanze più frequenti degli incidenti rilevati.
https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/european-road-safety-observatory/statistics-and-analysis-archive/young-people/impairment_en — la guida richiede attenzione al traffico.

rows.text: Following too closely can leave too little room to stop when the vehicle ahead slows down. Insufficient distance is a significant recorded crash circumstance.
evidence: https://www.istat.it/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/REPORT_INCIDENTI_STRADALI_2024.pdf, prospetto 9 e sezione sulle circostanze — distrazione, precedenza, velocità e distanza tra le circostanze più frequenti degli incidenti rilevati.

rows.text: Fatigue reduces alertness and can lengthen reaction times, increasing crash risk.
evidence: https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/document/download/09dca415-306c-401a-9c97-8afd174ca36e_en?filename=road_safety_thematic_report_fatigue_tc_final.pdf — la stanchezza aumenta il rischio di incidente; https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/european-road-safety-observatory/statistics-and-analysis-archive/fatigue/driving-behaviour_en — riduce vigilanza e rallenta le reazioni.

rows.text: Defective suspension can impair control of the vehicle and contribute to a crash.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/annex-6-vehicle-maintenance-safety-and-security — guasti ai freni e ammortizzatori usurati compromettono sicurezza e funzionamento.

https://www.gov.uk/guidance/mot-inspection-manual-for-private-passenger-and-light-commercial-vehicles/5-axles-wheels-tyres-and-suspension — una molla mancante che compromette il controllo direzionale è difetto pericoloso.

rows.text: Worn tread provides less grip, especially on wet roads, increasing the risk of losing control.
evidence: https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle-safety/tires — il battistrada dà aderenza e contrasta lo slittamento, soprattutto sul bagnato.

rows.text: If the brakes malfunction, stopping can become difficult or impossible, potentially causing a crash.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/annex-6-vehicle-maintenance-safety-and-security — guasti ai freni e ammortizzatori usurati compromettono sicurezza e funzionamento.

rows.text: The tachograph records journey data and driver activity; its failure is not among the most frequent crash causes. Common circumstances include distraction, failure to yield and speed.
evidence: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2014/165/oj/eng, art. 2 e allegato I — il tachigrafo registra movimento e periodi di attività del conducente.

https://www.istat.it/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/REPORT_INCIDENTI_STRADALI_2024.pdf, prospetto 9 e sezione sulle circostanze — distrazione, precedenza, velocità e distanza tra le circostanze più frequenti degli incidenti rilevati.

rows.text: An injection pump failure is not among the most frequent recorded crash causes; common errors include distraction, failure to yield and excessive speed.
evidence: https://www.istat.it/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/REPORT_INCIDENTI_STRADALI_2024.pdf, prospetto 9 e sezione sulle circostanze — distrazione, precedenza, velocità e distanza tra le circostanze più frequenti degli incidenti rilevati.

rows.text: An extinguisher is used to tackle a fire in its early stages. Its absence concerns fire response and is not a direct cause of a road collision.
evidence: https://www.hse.gov.uk/cdg/faqs.htm — dotazione di estintori per il trasporto di merci pericolose; https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/69d7a17369de22b2bf86f6af/JSP_317_Defence_fuels_policy__organisation_and_safety_regulations_-_Part_2_-_Guidance.pdf — uso degli estintori su piccoli incendi iniziali quando sicuro.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE, but that does not mean there is no risk: the pump circulates coolant, and a failure can cause overheating and engine stalling. In some cases loss of propulsion can increase crash risk.
evidence: Official CQC 31845 printed FALSO; wording gives no qualification of risk mechanism or frequency.

Mercedes-Benz recall 2019090019, NHTSA 19V605 https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/rcl/2019/RCMN-19V605-7125.pdf p.2 — pump electrical supply fault can cause coolant temperature increase, engine stall and increased crash risk; specific configuration, no claim all pump failures produce stalls.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE. A clogged air filter restricts engine air and can cause irregular operation: check and replace it according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The question specifies neither the severity of the fault nor evidence that every blockage increases crash risk.
evidence: Official CQC 31846 printed FALSO: question does not specify severity; source below does not quantify crashes or establish a universal risk.

Audi service bulletin 01 17 20 https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2017/MC-10127741-9999.pdf p.2 — clogged air filter can restrict airflow and contribute to misfire and fault codes; manufacturer example, no claimed established collision statistic.

Oak Ridge National Laboratory 2015 presentation, backup slide 26, https://www.energy.gov/sites/prod/files/2015/06/f24/ti057_west_2015_o.pdf — controlled study of five gasoline and three diesel vehicles: clogged intake filters reduced full-power acceleration; no collision rates measured.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE: fuel type alone does not automatically increase crash risk. Vehicle condition and driving also matter, and fuel systems require safety measures appropriate to the fuel.
evidence: Official CQC 31847 printed FALSO; no causal mechanism or fuel comparison is specified.

NHTSA FMVSS 303 laboratory procedure appendix D https://www.nhtsa.gov/sites/nhtsa.gov/files/tp-303-00.pdf p.79 — CNG fuel-system integrity requirements reduce fire injury from leakage during or after crashes, for specified vehicle categories; safety provisions are not proof of equal collision rates for all fuel types.

SWANA and NGVAmerica, Natural Gas: A Clean, Safe and Smart Choice for the Waste and Recycling Industry, p.2, DOE-hosted https://afdc.energy.gov/files/u/publication/Natural-Gas-A-Clean-Safe-and-Smart-Choice-for-the-Waste-Recycling-Industry.pdf — industry authors say properly operated and maintained natural-gas vehicles can be as safe as gasoline or diesel; all vehicles have risks. This is not a universal collision-rate comparison.

rows.text: Traffic psychology studies how personal and social factors influence travel and driving choices, including to promote safety and sustainable mobility.
evidence: Primary study, The Role of Infrastructural and Psychological Factors in Sustainable Transportation Mode Choices (2025) https://duepublico2.uni-due.de/servlets/MCRFileNodeServlet/duepublico_derivate_00083843/applsci_2025_15_5953.pdf — transport-mode choices, psychological factors and sustainability; empirical study, not proof of all traffic-psychology results.

Opinion article Patterns of Drivers Traffic Behavior in Three Countries (2022) https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/psychology/articles/10.3389/fpsyg.2022.869029/pdf?isPublishedV2=false — individual and social features of safe/risky driving behaviour.

rows.text: Concentration helps a driver observe traffic and recognize hazards. If attention moves elsewhere, driving decisions and reactions can deteriorate.
evidence: https://road-safety.transport.ec.europa.eu/european-road-safety-observatory/statistics-and-analysis-archive/young-people/impairment_en — il compito di guida richiede attenzione continua al traffico; la distrazione la sposta altrove.

source_access_notes: Independently inspected Mercedes-Benz 19V605 actual recall p.2–3, Audi 01 17 20 actual p.2, ORNL vehicle research presentation, SWANA/NGVA industry publication, INAIL accident definitions and case materials, and ISTAT 2024 crash report. Water pump and fuel claims correctly retain model/source scope and non-universality; no crash rate extrapolation.
Rechecked Audi actual bulletin identifier 01 17 20 across all languages and English 31827 removes unsupported externality condition; prior reviewer findings resolved.

issues.reason: La risposta stampata VERO afferma che ogni danno organico o funzionale conseguente al lavoro è un infortunio. La definizione distingue invece gli eventi a causa violenta dalle malattie professionali a causa lenta; il testo non limita il danno a eventi improvvisi.
checked_sources: https://www.inail.it/portale/assicurazione/it/lassicurazione-inail/La-tutela-assicurativa-nell-ue/Incidenti-e-infortuni-sul-lavoro.html — richiede causa violenta e occasione di lavoro.

https://www.inail.it/portale/assicurazione/it/Datore-di-Lavoro/Impresa-Settore-Navigazione/denunce-infortuni-e-malattie-professionali-impresa-settore-navigazione/denuncia-malattia-professionale-impresa-settore-navigazione.html — malattia professionale con causa lenta e progressiva.

issues.reason: La risposta stampata FALSO esclude senza qualificazioni che un guasto alla pompa dell’acqua aumenti il rischio di incidente; un richiamo documenta invece che il malfunzionamento della pompa del refrigerante del motore può causare arresto e aumentare il rischio. Non è esplicitato se il quesito intenda soltanto una causa diretta o frequente.
checked_sources: https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/rcl/2019/RCMN-19V605-7125.pdf — richiamo Mercedes-Benz 2019: malfunzionamento della pompa refrigerante motore, possibile arresto e aumento del rischio di incidente.
https://www.istat.it/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/REPORT_INCIDENTI_STRADALI_2024.pdf, prospetto 9 — elenca le circostanze più frequenti, ma non risolve la formulazione generale del quesito.

issues.reason: Evidence identifies the linked Audi bulletin as 24 17 88, but the actual PDF is 01 17 20 (2029233/4, 9 June 2017). Correct the identifier; p.2 supports the stated clogging/misfire mechanism.

Sudden external cause adds an externality condition absent from Italian and can mislead about compensable work-related physical exertion. INAIL jurisprudence recognizes qualifying physical effort as causa violenta; avoid the extra qualifier.

source_access_notes: Independently inspected Mercedes-Benz 19V605 actual recall p.2–3, Audi 01 17 20 actual p.2, ORNL vehicle research presentation, SWANA/NGVA industry publication, INAIL accident definitions and case materials, and ISTAT 2024 crash report. Water pump and fuel claims correctly retain model/source scope and non-universality; no crash rate extrapolation.
